request: Add circular feature that will act as a attachment for hanging rope. Outer D=4cm and feature has a concentric hole D=2cm. Thickness is 3cm. Feature is touching tangentially vertical surface of the bigger feature of the whistle with its hole and axis is parallel to this surface. Try to centre the feature to the aforementioned surface

actions.operation: Add protruding cylindrical ring (boss) feature (annular extrusion) to the whistle body
actions.target: Whistle body (new feature added onto existing solid)
actions.relational_constraint: Place the added feature so its outer cylindrical surface is tangent to the referenced vertical surface of the bigger whistle feature; orient the feature axis parallel to that vertical surface; try to center the feature relative to that surface
actions.unresolved_reference: Which specific face is the 'vertical surface of the bigger feature of the whistle'; what definition of 'vertical' applies in the model coordinate system; what 'center' means for that surface (midpoint of face bounding box, midpoint between edges, centered on an existing datum/plane, etc.); exact tangency location along the surface (where on the face the tangency occurs). Note: a purely tangent-touching union of two solids can create a non-manifold condition; in practice the ring typically needs either a small overlap into the body or a blending fillet/gusset to be manufacturable and robust.
steps: Interpret the 'bigger feature' as the rounded head/grip block (SEC-01) based on the multiviews showing the large rounded-end mass; select the planar vertical side face on that head as the attachment reference: Head front wide face (face_code 0001, Brep_id FACE 26).

Create a sketch on face_code 0001 (use the face itself as the sketch plane). Establish sketch center by constraining a point at the face center: add midpoint constraints by making the point equidistant from the top and bottom edges of the face and equidistant from the left and right edges of the face (i.e., center of the face bounding box in X and Z on that plane).
Sketch two concentric circles: outer circle Ø40 mm and inner circle Ø20 mm, both centered on the face-center point. Apply a concentric constraint between the circles and dimension both diameters.

Extrude the annular sketch (outer minus inner) by 30 mm as an ADD/JOIN feature. Set extrusion direction normal to the selected face and outward from the body (i.e., away from the solid volume of the head). Use a merge/join boolean to ensure it becomes a single solid with the whistle body.

To satisfy the intent of 'touching tangentially' at the interface and to improve durability (rope load), apply a small edge blend at the ring-to-body junction: add a fillet (typ. R2–R5 mm, as allowed by design) on the intersection edge(s) between the new ring boss and face_code 0001 so the transition is tangent-smooth and reduces stress concentration.

actions.operation: Create concentric through hole in the added circular feature
actions.target: The newly added circular feature from previous action
actions.relational_constraint: Hole axis coincident with the added feature axis (concentric)
actions.unresolved_reference: Confirm hole goes fully through the 3cm thickness (implied) and confirm no additional countersink/counterbore is intended. Also confirm the hole should only pass through the added ring thickness and not continue into the whistle body; if 'through all' is used it may unintentionally pierce the head block.
steps: Select the outer end face of the newly extruded ring boss (the planar face created at the end of the 30 mm extrusion) as the sketch/feature start face for the hole operation.

Create a sketch on that ring end face. Project/convert the outer ring circle edge or use the boss cylindrical axis to place the hole center; constrain the hole center concentric with the ring boss outer cylindrical face (use the boss axis as the concentric reference).
Sketch a circle Ø20 mm at the concentric center.

Perform a CUT-EXTRUDE along the ring axis direction back toward the whistle body with a depth of 30 mm (or an 'Up to face' termination to the ring base interface at face_code 0001) so the hole passes through the ring thickness only while remaining concentric to the ring boss.

intention: Provide an attachment point for hanging a rope from the whistle
